BJD Criticizes BJP Government Over FCI Rice Lifting Delays in Odisha

The Biju Janata Dal (BJD) has criticized the BJP-led government regarding delays in the lifting of rice by the Food Corporation of India (FCI) in Odisha. The BJD claims that the failure to lift the rice in a timely manner could cause financial and logistical trouble for farmers in the state. The party is targeting the central government's administration of the FCI over these procurement delays.
